### TRAVIS MILLER

[[**Travis Miller**]{.underline}](https://www.linkedin.com/in/travismiller09/) is the **SVP (Senior Vice President) of Sales and Client Development at PureSpectrum**, a prominent market research technology and sample platform provider. 

Key details regarding his role and background include:

- **PureSpectrum Career:** He has been with PureSpectrum for over eight years. Before being promoted to Senior Vice President, he served as the company's Vice President of North American Sales for the West region.

- **Industry Leadership:** He is highly active in the broader market research ecosystem, serving as the **President of the Insights Association West Chapter Board**.

- **Professional Focus:** He has over 15 years of industry experience specializing in client success, sales leadership, and data quality within the market research sample space

LINKEDIN - <https://www.linkedin.com/in/travismiller09/>

3.  Market Research and Insights Career Paths
    - Market Research and Insights have a tremendous amount of career paths and opportunities. Impact on technology over the last 15 years in our industry has dramatically changes the type of careers available in our industry and will continue to change for the foreseeable future.

      - Getting started can be challenging

      - take courses that involve stats and econ

      - Additionally, keep track of current events

      - Find a problem that need answers, collect the data, provide answers

    - Finding an internship, or opportunity to conduct market research

      - Market research agencies are a great starting point

        - find a Company that interests you

        - Brands tend to look for more experience

      - Vendors are an option, so compnaies that support market research but may not conduct the actual market reseacrch. Survey platforms, sample companies, interviewing locations

        - Drawback - this is starting point you amke not get the analytical knowledge needed

        - this does open a door to also to branch

      - One you understand the basics, the options are limitless

      - One area that i do not feel gets a lot of attention is the entrepreneurial spirit of the MR/insights
